Milestone 16B — Visual Review
APPROVED — Visual inspection passed

The Contact page now looks correct. No additional visual corrections are necessary before closing Milestone 16B.

The new Email, LinkedIn, and GitHub rows are consistently aligned. Their typography, spacing, and dividers match the existing design.

The page retains a clear hierarchy between the main heading, introductory text, signal indicator, and contact methods.

There is no visible text clipping, element overlap, or unintended horizontal overflow.

The existing dark theme and technical typography remain consistent.

2. Mobile — PASS

The mobile implementation also passes visual inspection.

The contact information stacks vertically, with labels above their corresponding values. This is appropriate for the narrower viewport.

The email address and profile links fit within the available width without clipping.

The navigation, introductory text, signal indicator, contact rows, and response-time text are all visible.

The new rows also preserve sufficient spacing between individual contact methods.

No responsive-layout correction is needed.

3. Minor observations

These are not blockers for Milestone 16B.

Leave it unchanged for now.

The contact links appear white rather than prominently cyan in the screenshots. This is not necessarily a defect.

The consistent row styling is visually appropriate. Browser testing should confirm that the links have recognizable hover and keyboard-focus states.

Development indicator

The circular Next.js development indicator remains visible near the lower-left corner.

This is expected when capturing the development build. Verify that it is absent from the production version during the final website audit.
